_provenance: Transcribed from the completed 610-sample run in scripts/run_benchmark_resumable.py --score on 2026-10-15. Committed so the model card can be regenerated without a GPU. Per-sample rows are in naic_benchmark_results.csv; all 1,220 completions are published at https://huggingface.co/datasets/lanre-segun/lumina-edu-benchmark-results

language_regression._note: Primary finding. Share of prompts requesting a Nigerian language that were answered in one, detected by presence of non-ASCII characters. Base N-ATLaS honoured these prompts; the English-only-trained adapter did not.
language_regression._caveat: Language is detected by non-ASCII presence, a proxy that miscounts undiacritised responses as English and so understates the fine-tuned model. Prompt language rotates by record index rather than a verified per-record label, so buckets are non-English prompt groups rather than confirmed per-language targets.

metric_validity._note: Why ROUGE/chrF are not headlined. The benchmark reference is the source abstract, so reproducing it scores highly.

metric_note: ROUGE uses an English stemmer and is unreliable for Yoruba/Hausa/Igbo; chrF is the reported metric for those languages. Neither is headlined here, because the benchmark reference is the source abstract and 272/610 completions exceed 0.90 ROUGE-L, indicating extraction-by-echo rather than summarisation.
